name: spec
description: Spec pipeline v7 — a small code program run by a trusted engineer, verified by executed evidence. Lifecycle: /spec:genesis (greenfield) → roadmap briefs → /spec:mocks → /spec:plan → /spec:run (build, then review, each driver-stepped with one fresh-context reviewer and a derived verdict) → /spec:release; plus /spec:status, /spec:doctor, /spec:enforce, /spec:fix. Changelog (last 3): 7.301.0 — core § Doctrine Authoring now names the three kinds of prose pin (references, retired phrases, protocol tokens) and states that a pin on the wording of a rule is not a test; wording is read by review. 7.300.0 — Compatibility paths that no host needs are deleted: retired flags now fall to each script's generic unknown-flag refusal (exit 2 unchanged), genesis status brief drops its legacy key, and the init hook's consume arm narrows to the two live design values. 7.299.0 — red-check.js now applies the host's declared testCountPattern to each run's output and raises the hard finding vacuous-green when a sanctioned-green file executed no test (one warning when the pattern is undeclared); memory-sweep.js matches changed paths without an extension list so non-JS hosts surface agent memory for disposal, and an uncommitted note ages from its file mtime.
